# massdriver_service_account_group_membership (Resource)

Adds a service account to a group, granting it the group's permissions. A service account can belong to several groups; its effective permissions are the union. Memberships are immutable — changing either ID replaces the membership.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A new service account has no permissions until it joins a group.
resource "massdriver_group" "deployers" {
  name = "Deployers"
}

resource "massdriver_service_account" "ci" {
  name                     = "ci-deployer"
  token_expiration_minutes = 525600
}

resource "massdriver_service_account_group_membership" "ci_deployers" {
  group_id           = massdriver_group.deployers.id
  service_account_id = massdriver_service_account.ci.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) ID of the group (a `massdriver_group` ID, or a built-in group such as `organization_admin`). Immutable.
- `service_account_id` (String) ID of the service account to add (a `massdriver_service_account` ID). Immutable.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import takes the composite <group_id>/<service_account_id> form.
terraform import massdriver_service_account_group_membership.ci_deployers <group_id>/<service_account_id>
```
